description: Email the saved human decision, or the recommendation before a decision, back to the broker over the Gmail connection's confirm surface, then record the outbound reply on the submission. Requires a saved risk finding and the exact confirmed recipient, subject, and final body. Rejects a changed preview before sending. Fired only from the operator-confirmed Send reply action via the direct-invoke lane; not listed in any agent's tools, so the model cannot call it.

submission_id.description: The submission whose outcome to send, e.g. sub_bistro_ember.

confirmation.description: The exact email the operator reviewed. Must match the current recipient, subject, and body, including any operator note.

message.description: Optional operator note prepended to the reply body.
